t.zh: 用 1 元、2 元、5 元的硬币凑出 5 元，有几种凑法？每种硬币要多少有多少，只看用了哪些硬币，不看先后：1 + 2 + 2 和 2 + 1 + 2 算同一种。
t.en: How many ways are there to make 5 yuan from 1-, 2- and 5-yuan coins? There are as many of each coin as you like, and only which coins you use counts, not their order: 1 + 2 + 2 and 2 + 1 + 2 are the same way.

t.zh: 表是背包表的样子：行是硬币，列是金额。第 0 行「不用硬币」只凑得出 0 元，算 1 种，已经填好了。
t.en: The table looks like the knapsack table: rows are coins, columns are amounts. Row 0, “no coins”, only makes 0 yuan, which counts as 1 way; it is filled in already.

goal.zh: 算出凑出这个金额，一共有几种凑法。
goal.en: Work out how many ways there are to make the amount.

how.en: Row by row, left to right.

hints.zh: 这一行的凑法分成两种：一枚这种硬币都不用，或者至少用一枚。
hints.en: This row’s ways split in two: no coin of this kind at all, or at least one.

hints.zh: 至少用一枚的：拿掉一枚，剩下的金额还能用这种硬币，所以还在这一行。
hints.en: With at least one: take one off, and what is left may still use this coin, so it stays on this row.

body.zh: 按硬币一行一行算，每种凑法只数一次：它用到哪几种硬币，就在哪几行里长出来，先后不同也不会多数。
body.en: Going one coin to a row, every way is counted once: it grows on the rows of the coins it uses, so a different order is never counted again.
